understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal with MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity carries the player until landing or reaching the goal. CLICK removes a targeted clickable breakable tile without changing position, and UNDO reverts the previous action. Landing on spikes ends an attempt; each level provides two attempts with a 50-turn limit. Passage columns in the corridor scan indicate useful gravity drops and should be prioritized.
